{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Print total number of rows in the original dataset
print(f"Total rows in original dataset: {len(data)}")

# Deduplicate on patient_id by keeping the row with the highest sample_seq per patient_id
data_dedup = data.loc[data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Print the number of unique patients after deduplication
print(f"Number of unique patients after deduplication: {len(data_dedup)}")

# Final count
num_patients = len(data_dedup)
print(num_patients)"}
